article.title: Common mistake: 'discuss about' vs 'discuss'
article.description: Wrong: 'Let's discuss about the plan.' Right: 'Let's discuss the plan.' Teaching point: 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about' — adding 'about' after it is redundant, though very common among learners.
article.content: Wrong: 'Let's discuss about the plan.' Right: 'Let's discuss the plan.' Teaching point: 'discuss' is a transitive verb that already means 'talk about' — adding 'about' after it is redundant, though very common among learners.

generated.caption:
Ever caught yourself saying 'discuss about'? 👋 It's a common mistake!

'Discuss' already means 'talk about,' so adding 'about' is redundant. Just remember: 'discuss' stands alone.

For example, instead of 'Let's discuss about the plan,' say 'Let's discuss the plan.'

Easy, right? Save this tip & follow @EnglishVault for more daily lessons! #EnglishVault #LearnEnglish

Toh iske saath 'about' lagana poori tarah se galat hai, redundant hai. Ye ek transitive verb hai, iske baad seedha object aata hai. Jaise, 'Let's discuss the plan.' Ye sahi hai. 'Let's discuss about the plan' galat hai. Toh remember, 'discuss' ke baad kabhi bhi 'about' nahi aayega. Seedha object. 'Let's discuss the plan!' Ab samajh aaya? slides.body: Many English learners often make a common mistake by saying 'discuss about'. However, the verb 'discuss' is already transitive, meaning 'to talk about' a subject. Adding 'about' after it is therefore redundant and incorrect. For example, instead of the common error 'Let's discuss about the plan,' the grammatically correct sentence is 'Let's discuss the plan.' Always remember to use 'discuss' directly with the topic you are talking about.
slides.hindiSummary: "Discuss" शब्द का अर्थ 'किसी विषय पर चर्चा करना' होता है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'about' लगाना अनावश्यक और गलत है।
